label: scam
title: Buy gold bars, a 'federal courier' will collect them (dollar-bill passcode)
sources: IC3 PSA 240129: couriers collect cash or gold from seniors to 'protect' funds
FTC Data Spotlight Aug 2025: 'False alarm, real scam' -- accounts/SSN 'compromised'

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is Officer Reed, Treasury Department. To keep your savings safe from the identity thieves, you must convert it to gold.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Withdraw the cash and buy gold bars at the dealer I name. A federal courier will come to your house tonight to secure them.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Someone is coming to my house?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes. Give him the gold only after he reads you the serial number of the dollar bill I'm about to give you. Tell no one, not even your children.
